mapping_findings: No current-parent row-shift bug found. Stable original/addition IDs are kept; deleted source IDs remain None; inherited additions shift with surviving rows; appended additions follow survivors; complete-bijection and exact-before-text checks protect row correspondence.

findings.finding: Addition coordinates are not checked against reviewed pixel metadata, unlike replacement coordinates. Geometry/counts alone do not catch a valid in-frame typo.
findings.recommendation: Require all four added bbox coordinates and both added keypoint triplets to match explicit reviewed pixel values within the same tolerance.

findings.location: compose / added visible endpoint evidence gate
findings.finding: Literal string comparison == 2 does not match the parser accepting numeric equivalents such as 2.0 or 2e0; these representations skip the actual-corner-evidence gate.
findings.recommendation: Require canonical visibility tokens 0 or 2, or branch on the validated numeric state.

findings.location: replacement / bbox edits and main unreviewed_tokens_preserved report
findings.finding: An edit restricted to bbox.top can reformat unchanged x-center and width tokens because only reconstructed edges are checked. This is coordinate-preserving but the blanket byte/token-preservation claim is stronger than enforced.
findings.recommendation: For only vertical-edge edits preserve old cx/width tokens; for only horizontal-edge edits preserve old cy/height tokens, or narrow the reported guarantee to endpoint tokens and undeclared coordinate values.

observed_fix: Explicit non-target deletion path now records exact discarded endpoint tokens and physical-feature reasons; do not zero false points first or revert this justified path.
testing: Only direct parser/geometry and replacement helpers were exercised with synthetic numeric examples. No compose mutation, GPU or inference.
